cases.title: Operator opens Run from the left nav

fixtures.text: Browser at the local operator-console base URL. Use project test-env names for sign-in. Never write a real password.

steps.do: Open the local operator console in the browser
If a sign-in screen is shown, fill the operator email and password from the project test env (names only, no secret values) and submit
Confirm you landed on the dashboard (main heading visible)
Click Run in the left-hand navigation

expected.see: The dashboard is visible after sign-in
The Run page shows the start-run form

cases.e2e_reason: This AC is a user-visible navigation path; a unit or API check cannot see the left nav.
